description: This file defines constants, macros, structures, and function prototypes for DNS Service Discovery (DNS-SD) in Zephyr OS. It includes macros for registering DNS-SD services, constants for name sizes, and functions for handling DNS-SD records.

methods.name: dns_sd_txt_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the DNS TXT record data in a dns_sd_rec structure.

methods.name: dns_sd_is_service_type_enumeration
methods.description: Checks if a given dns_sd_rec represents a DNS-SD Service Type Enumeration.

methods.name: dns_sd_create_wildcard_filter
methods.description: Creates a wildcard filter for DNS-SD records.
